verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Paxos accepting natural-language commands to operate the platform, such as running transfers, orders or onboarding. The AI assistant built into the documentation only gives contextual help with the APIs. llms.txt and llms-full.txt are content indexes that external AI tools could use, which makes them adjacent developer building blocks rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
